caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of a series of dark green cords or ropes that converge at a circular ring at the top. From the ring, the cords fan out and then descend vertically, forming a rectangular, tightly grouped segment that appears to be woven or bundled together. At the bottom edge of this rectangular section, individual cords extend downward, each finished with a loop, and some of the loops are linked together in small groups. The loops and a portion of the cords are rendered in a lighter, grayish color compared to the dark green of the main bundle. The background of the drawing is an off-white or light beige with no additional objects present, allowing the focus to remain on the central hanging object. The artist's name, "Byron A. Dimchar," is printed in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Twin Beaded Bag
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
